en.title: Mashed Fried Eggplant with Garlic Yogurt (Beitinjan Mifassakh)
en.intro: Recipe 153, page 71 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Slice and salt the eggplants for an hour, then squeeze and pat dry.
steps.n2: Fry them in olive oil until soft and brown.
steps.n3: Mash with the yogurt and garlic.
steps.n4: Stir in the parsley and serve.

legacySteps: Slice and salt the eggplants for an hour, then squeeze and pat dry.
Fry them in olive oil until soft and brown.
Mash with the yogurt and garlic.
Stir in the parsley and serve.
